title: 单链表实现
description: 节点 + 头指针 + 尾插

points.hint: 💡 空表时新节点直接当头
💡 否则走到表尾再接入

hints.level_1: 💡 空表时新节点直接当头
hints.level_2: 📖 链表：节点+指针；虚拟头节点、快慢指针、就地反转是高频套路

explanation: 链表访问靠指针逐个走：没有随机访问，但插入删除只需改指针。

title: 头插法建表
description: 每次在头部插入实现逆序
full_code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None

head = None
for v in (1, 2, 3, 4):
    node = Node(v)
    node.next = head
    head = node

vals = []
cur = head
while cur:
    vals.append(str(cur.value))
    cur = cur.next
print(" -> ".join(vals))

points.hint: 💡 新节点先接管旧头
💡 再让 head 指向新节点

hints.level_2: 📖 链表：节点+指针；虚拟头节点、快慢指针、就地反转是高频套路

explanation: 头插法：先接后断。顺序输入得到逆序链表——两行指针操作就是一次反转。

title: 反转链表

title: 中间节点
description: 快慢指针一次扫描找中点

points.hint: 💡 慢指针一步快指针两步
💡 快指针到头时慢指针恰在中点

hints.level_1: 💡 慢指针一步快指针两步
hints.level_2: 📖 链表：节点+指针；虚拟头节点、快慢指针、就地反转是高频套路
hints.level_3: 👀 接近答案：`slow = fast = head`、`fast = fast.next.next`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：`slow = fast = head`；`fast = fast.next.next`

explanation: 快慢指针不需要先数长度：fast 走两步 slow 走一步，fast 到尾时 slow 在中点。

title: 回文链表
description: 复制值到数组后与反转比较
full_code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next=None):
        self.value = value
        self.next = next

def is_palindrome(head):
    vals = []
    cur = head
    while cur:
        vals.append(cur.value)
        cur = cur.next
    return vals == vals[::-1]

head = Node(1, Node(2, Node(2, Node(1))))
print(is_palindrome(head))
head2 = Node(1, Node(2))
print(is_palindrome(head2))

points.hint: 💡 先线性扫描收集所有值
💡 数组与其反转相等即为回文

hints.level_1: 💡 先线性扫描收集所有值
hints.level_2: 📖 链表：节点+指针；虚拟头节点、快慢指针、就地反转是高频套路

explanation: 入门解法 O(n) 空间；进阶做法是快慢指针找中点后反转后半段，空间降到 O(1)。

title: 合并有序链表

points.hint: 💡 虚拟头节点简化边界
💡 每次摘下较小节点接到 tail

hints.level_2: 📖 链表：节点+指针；虚拟头节点、快慢指针、就地反转是高频套路
hints.level_3: 👀 接近答案：`dummy = Node(0)`、`tail.next, a = a, a.next`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：`dummy = Node(0)`；`tail.next, a = a, a.next`

💡 快指针到尾时慢指针恰在待删节点前一个

title: 环检测
full_code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next=None):
        self.value = value
        self.next = next

def has_cycle(head):
    slow = fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
        if slow is fast:
            return True
    return False

a = Node(1)
b = Node(2)
c = Node(3)
a.next, b.next, c.next = b, c, a
print(has_cycle(a))
print(has_cycle(Node(1)))

points.hint: 💡 慢一次快两次追逐
💡 在环内快指针终将追上慢指针

hints.level_2: 📖 链表：节点+指针；虚拟头节点、快慢指针、就地反转是高频套路
hints.level_3: 👀 接近答案：`if slow is fast:`、`return False`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：`if slow is fast:`；`return False`

explanation: Floyd 判圈：有环时快指针必在环内追上慢指针；无环时 fast 先到 nil。

title: 双向链表
description: prev 与 next 双向链接

points.hint: 💡 新节点 prev 接旧尾 next 接空
💡 维护 head 与 tail 两个指针

hints.level_1: 💡 新节点 prev 接旧尾 next 接空
hints.level_2: 📖 链表：节点+指针；虚拟头节点、快慢指针、就地反转是高频套路

explanation: 双向链表每个节点两条指针：既能前进也能后退，删除已知节点只需 O(1)（LRU 缓存的基石）。

title: 链表两数相加
full_code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next=None):
        self.value = value
        self.next = next

def add_two(l1, l2):
    dummy = Node(0)
    cur, carry = dummy, 0
    while l1 or l2 or carry:
        total = carry
        if l1:
            total += l1.value
            l1 = l1.next
        if l2:
            total += l2.value
            l2 = l2.next
        carry, digit = divmod(total, 10)
        cur.next = Node(digit)
        cur = cur.next
    return dummy.next

def to_list(head):
    out = []
    while head:
        out.append(head.value)
        head = head.next
    return out

a = Node(2, Node(4, Node(3)))
b = Node(5, Node(6, Node(4)))
print(to_list(add_two(a, b)))

points.hint: 💡 两链表逐位相加并处理进位

points.text: while l1 or l2 or carry:
points.hint: 💡 divmod 一次拿到本位与进位

hints.level_1: 💡 两链表逐位相加并处理进位
hints.level_2: 📖 链表：节点+指针；虚拟头节点、快慢指针、就地反转是高频套路
hints.level_3: 👀 接近答案：`carry, digit = divmod(total, 10)`、`while l1 or l2 or carry:`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：`carry, digit = divmod(total, 10)`；`while l1 or l2 or carry:`

explanation: 342+465=807：位数逆序存储正好从低位加起。循环条件带上 carry，防止最后一位进位丢失。
